Played basketball and golf at Highland Park High School and won the individual state title in golf three years in a row (2012-2014).Has three sisters: Callie, Sara and Molly. Callie played golf at Texas A&M and caddied for her brother as he competed in U.S. Opens as an amateur.Played collegiate golf at the University of Texas where his teammates included Beau Hossler, Kramer Hickok and Doug Ghim.Is involved with Triumph Over Kid Cancer, an organization started by his childhood friend, James Ragan, who passed away at the age of 20.Loves to play pickup basketball.Made a cameo appearance in Happy Gilmore 2, released on Netflix in July 2025.Amateur HighlightsWas the low amateur at the 2017 U.S. Open at Erin Hills.R1Groupings OfficialRBC HeritageD.
